item.title: How do I book an appointment?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Use the booking button in the header, call us, or send a message from the Contact page.

item.title: How long does a typical visit take?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Each service lists its duration. Most visits take between 30 and 90 minutes.

item.title: Can I change or cancel my booking?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes. Please let us know at least 24 hours in advance so we can offer the time to someone else.

item.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: We accept cash and major cards. You can edit this answer to match your own policy.

item.title: Do you offer gift vouchers?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes, vouchers are available for any service or amount. Contact us to arrange one.

item.title: How does membership work?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Members receive member pricing and priority booking for a year. See the Membership page for details.

item.title: What to Expect on Your First Visit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your first visit starts with a short conversation about what you need. From there we suggest a plan and explain every step.

Feel free to ask questions at any point.

item.title: Five Simple Tips for Staying Consistent
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Consistency matters more than intensity. Here are five simple habits that help: plan ahead, start small, track progress, celebrate wins and ask for support when you need it.
item.excerpt:encoded: Small habits that make a big difference.
